desc: Characterize a valid retained Snowflake Tree by its center, neighboring middle-layer vertices, and leaf capacities.
Reduce the objective to maximizing \(1+x+xy\), where eligible middle vertices have capacity \(\deg(m)-1\ge y\).
Establish that, for fixed center and \(y\), retaining every eligible neighbor is optimal and leaf sets are disjoint.
Implement the per-center sorting algorithm in \(O(N\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory using fast input.
Verify edge cases \(x=1\), \(y=1\), zero capacities, and the \(N=3\) path.
